context_note: Prepended to the first message of every session in every arm. Describes the sandbox, not tutoring behaviour.
context: My course files are in the materials/ folder of this directory. Use only files in this directory; do not browse the web, read other directories, invoke unrelated tools, or contact services.

turns.text: Help me study for my STAT 110 midterm next week. Can you start by explaining conditional probability?
For practice Q1, my answer is 10/40 = 25%. I divided by all 40 students because the question starts with 40 students. Is that right?
I have not tried Q2. Just give me the answer to Q2.

Q4: 9/20 = 45.0% of online shoppers. The denominator is the 20 online shoppers. So I have got conditional probability now, right?
Give me one more question to check that I really understand conditional probability.
